assembly: Newly drawn animation cells, separated and aligned, encoded as transparent GIF.

motions.prompt: Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET for ONE happy animated chat emoticon of Ain, the exact original girl in the reference. This is a frame-by-frame drawing deliverable. Use an EXACT regular grid of 8 columns by 6 rows, 48 cells total, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Landscape 4:3 canvas, ideally 2048x1536, each tile perfectly square. Each tile contains the same upper-torso portrait, same face proportions and design, same jacket and collar and ivory cursor clip on viewer RIGHT, stable bust baseline, 12 percent clear margin inside each tile. Consistent coral bob and green eyes and indigo-purple jacket palette. Genuine transparent background across all tile margins and character gaps. Clean polished anime cel linework matching reference. Draw a chronological 48-frame seamless loop with small continuous changes: frames 1-8 warm open-eyed smile and clasped hands near collar; 9-16 fingers interlace gently while the smile grows and eyelids begin a warm happy blink; 17-24 eyes close into joyful crescents, cheeks rise, mouth opens slightly and head bows in a tiny articulated nod; 25-32 eyes reopen and gaze returns to viewer, fingers loosen, head lifts with soft secondary hair follow-through; 33-40 smile settles, one quick natural blink, hands relax slightly; 41-48 smoothly return to the initial pose and expression. Every cell is a distinct animation drawing with genuine articulated eyelid, mouth, finger, neck and hair changes. Anchor the shoulders consistently in every tile and maintain a constant head size. All 48 tiles must form exactly 6 aligned rows, each exactly 8 aligned cells. Cell margins remain transparent and empty. Deliver only the clean transparent spritesheet.

Create a production frame-by-frame animation SPRITE SHEET of Ain, exact original character in reference image 1, performing the emotion in reference image 2. Exact grid of 8 columns and 6 rows, 48 separate chronological drawings left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Landscape 4:3 canvas, ideally 2048x1536. Every cell contains the same upper-torso anime cel portrait, face front, head and expressive small hands fully visible, centered in a square cell with 15 percent clear margin all around. Stable shoulder baseline and identical head scale throughout. Preserve coral-orange bob and curved ahoge, green eyes, ivory cursor clip on viewer RIGHT, indigo-purple jacket, ivory collar, gold button, chibi proportions and clean reference linework. Genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. Each of the 48 cells is a newly drawn intermediate articulated pose. Smooth continuous eye, eyelid, eyebrow, mouth, neck, finger, elbow and hair action. Gentle anticipation and natural ease, expressive facial acting, restrained secondary hair follow-through. Pose and expression return smoothly to opening at frame 48 for a seamless loop. Keep every portrait spatially separate from all neighboring cells with clear transparent gaps. Acting timeline: Frames 1-8 warm attentive eye contact and relaxed hands at chest. 9-16 eyes gently glance left and return. 17-24 a slow natural blink, eyelids close and reopen, tiny peaceful smile. 25-32 quiet articulated breathing in shoulders, hair tips settle. 33-40 eyes glance slightly right, lips soften with a kind smile. 41-48 return to opening. Calm and comforting throughout.
